releaseNote.summary: An HTTP task can send a multipart/form-data body: mapping scripts add file parts as bytes (AddMultipartFile) and text fields (AddMultipartField), so a PDF or image reaches an upload API intact.

httpTaskMultipartBody.description: An HTTP task (type 6, and the deprecated 22) can send a multipart/form-data body built by its mapping script: HttpTask.AddMultipartFile (bytes, sent unchanged), AddMultipartField (UTF-8 text), ClearMultipart. With a part present, Body, RawBody and the content type are ignored. Run-time only; no component schema change. Before, a body string was sent as UTF-8, so no task type could deliver a file to an upload API. With http routed Remote, upgrade Execution before or with Orchestration: an older Execution host sends the request with no body.
